description: Implementation of a Value Addition Project for Rock Phosphate mined by Lanka Phosphate Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-26 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-08-04 to call for expressions of interest from suitable investors to implement a value addition project for rock phosphate mined by Lanka Phosphate Limited under public-private partnership. As per the said Cabinet decision, expressions of interest have been invited, and 14 expressions of interest have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to invite project proposals for the implementation of the proposed project from qualified investors selected after evaluating the said expressions of interest, was approved by the Cabinet.
